Name: Geruth Chimham
Description: The habitation of Chimham near Bethlehem, where Johanan and the captains stayed on their way to enter Egypt after Gedaliah's murder, fearing the Chaldeans.
BiblicalSignificance: Geruth Chimham is a stopping place on the road to exile: a lodging near Bethlehem where frightened leaders paused before fleeing to Egypt.
